Verify a signature is valid and has not been tampered with

Get signature statistics for compliance reporting. Requires audit:read permission.
Get current user's signature history with optional filters
Get all signatures for a specific resource
Check workflow completion status (how many signatures collected vs required)
Get a specific signature by ID
Invalidate a signature (super_admin only). Requires reason for audit trail.

item.description: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Compliant Electronic Signatures - Create, verify, and manage electronic signatures
